rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides access to the Google Apps Script API through 17 specialized tools covering project management, deployment operations, content updates, version control, process monitoring, and script execution. Built with Node.js and featuring OAuth 2.0 authentication with automatic token refresh, comprehensive logging capabilities, and enhanced error handling, it enables developers to programmatically manage Apps Script projects including creating and updating scripts, managing deployments, monitoring execution processes, and retrieving project metrics. The implementation supports both STDIO and SSE transport modes and is valuable for automating Apps Script workflows, CI/CD pipelines, project monitoring, and bulk operations across multiple script projects.
